title: UNS - Unified Numbering System
description: The Unified Numbering System (UNS) was developed by ASTM and SAE to correlate different numbering systems for commercial metals and alloys. The UNS number is an identification number that categorizes metals and alloys into 19 series, each representing different metal types and their compositions.

rows: Rare earth and rare earthlike metals and alloys
AISI and SAE carbon and alloy steels (except tool steels)
Reactive and refractory metals and alloys

components.content:
## Overview

The Unified Numbering System (UNS) provides a correlation between different commercial numbering systems for metals and alloys, developed jointly by ASTM and SAE.

### Key Information

- **Purpose**: Identification and classification of metals and alloys
- **Ferrous Metals and Alloys**: Series D, F, G, H, J, K, S, T, W
- **Nonferrous Metals and Alloys**: Series A, C, E, L, M, N, P, R, Z
- **Format**: Each series contains 99,999 designations

The UNS number itself is not a specification but rather serves as a reference identifier that correlates to specifications defined elsewhere.
